relations.justification: Social control generalises criminal sanction: punishment is one formal instrument among many informal ones.
Quantitative and qualitative findings on the same question support each other when they converge, and the convergence is itself the argument for mixed method.
Claims about social structure rest on the methods that measure it, and the methods constrain what can be claimed.
Market equilibrium and thermodynamic equilibrium are both stationary states reached by many interacting units under a maximisation principle, and the formal borrowing is historical.
Aggregate demand conditions drive the search frictions that produce cyclical unemployment.
Econometrics is statistics specialised to economic data and its identification problems.
Epidemiological study design is applied statistical inference; the identification problems are shared.
Econometric method is the tool international economics uses to make empirical claims.
Climate is the canonical global stock externality and a worked example of a scale-crossing system problem.
Accounting and economics share an origin in the measurement of commercial activity, though they separated early and answer different questions.
Realist accounts of international politics and democratic-peace claims disagree about whether regime type constrains state behaviour.
Policy evaluation is causal inference; the credibility of an evaluation is the credibility of its identification strategy.
Natural-law and positivist accounts of validity give incompatible answers to whether an unjust rule is law; the disagreement is the field's organising axis.
Comparative law presupposes the concepts — source, validity, interpretation — that jurisprudence supplies.
Customary international law and treaty law are distinguished by how consent is expressed, and the codification conventions turned much custom into treaty.
Judicial review is the mechanism by which constitutional rights acquire operative content; without it the guarantee is declaratory.
Commercial law is the law of obligations applied to enterprise; contract is its substrate.
Commercial law specialises the general law of obligations to transactions between enterprises.
Employment protection presupposes a social-security system to carry the risk that dismissal transfers; without it the protection is either nominal or absolute.
A patent grant is conditional on disclosure sufficient for a skilled reader to reproduce the invention; the claims define the right only against a description that enables it.
Transfer pricing adjustment operates inside the allocation of taxing rights that treaties establish; without the treaty framework there is no counterparty adjustment.
Merger control operates on the same theory of harm as the agreements prohibition — it asks whether a structure will produce the coordination that conduct rules forbid.
A lawful cross-border transfer presupposes a lawful processing basis; adequacy and safeguards address the destination, not the ground.
Electronic signature law and asymmetric cryptography are the legal and technical faces of one mechanism.
An arbitral award is worth what its enforcement is worth; the New York framework is what makes consensual adjudication commercially usable.
Economic geography is economics with location as an explicit variable.
Map projection is dimensional reasoning made visible: every projection trades one invariant for another and none preserves all.
A geographic information system is a spatially indexed database; its query model is the database's.
Land-use change is the proximate cause of most persistent anthropogenic landscape transformation.
Demography depends on census and survey infrastructure; its measures are only as good as the enumeration behind them.
Absolute archaeological chronology rests on radiochemistry — radiocarbon and related decay clocks are chemistry applied to dating.
